summary: Wayfinder motor uses IBM Bob Shell (ask mode, no tools) as a structured-extraction pipeline: HTML parsing seeds a procedure catalog, Bob fills gaps and adds everyday phrasings in parallel batches, a second Bob pass reviews each entry, and an MCP server exposes the catalog read-only to agents. All Bob output is validated against the original block IDs before any text is accepted.

workflow.observation: catalogFromHtml() extracts procedure entries directly from parsed municipal.tramite sections. Each entry is finished via finish(), which deduplicates destinations and computes faltantes. This runs before Bob is invoked and provides the baseline fichas array.

workflow.step: 2 – Rank and batch pages for Bob
workflow.observation: catalogDocuments() ranks pages by URL keywords and existing HTML ficha membership (html.has(p.id) adds +5), then slices to maxPages=40 and enforces per-page (10 000 chars) and total (200 000 chars) budgets at block granularity. Omitted block counts are recorded for quality reporting.

workflow.step: 3 – Bob extraction pass (parallel batches) + optional review pass
workflow.observation: organizeCatalog() splits documents into lotes (default 8 pages each), runs up to BOB_PARALELO=2 batches concurrently via enParalelo(). Each batch calls runBob with catalogPrompt, then if verificar≠'0' calls runBob again with reviewPrompt. Results are accepted only via acceptBobCatalog/acceptReview, which check every block/link ID against the originating document.

workflow.step: 4 – Citizen question answered via Bob with citation guard
workflow.observation: answerWithBob() builds a ranked evidence context (max 28 000 chars), calls runBob in ask mode (maxTurns=1, timeoutMs=55 000), then passes the JSON proposal through validateAnswer(). A 'Cifra sin cita.' error triggers a deterministic fallback message rather than surfacing Bob's uncited figure, and summaryOmitted is flagged in the response.

validation_gates.observation: acceptBobCatalog() enforces that every block and link ID returned by Bob exists in the originating document object. pagina_id, titulo_id (must be tipo='titulo', ≤240 chars), all field _ids arrays, and destino_ids are each checked against sources/blocks/linkMap. Any ID that cannot be resolved rejects the entire ficha and records a reason in rejected[].

validateAnswer() enforces: estado is one of three allowed values; mensaje ≤1600 chars and contains no URLs; fichas_ids and evidencia_ids have no duplicates and stay within count limits; every evidencia_id must belong to a cited ficha_id; any number in mensaje must appear literally in the cited evidence blocks. An aclaracion response is stripped to only its first ¿?-delimited question.

runBob() enforces a 2 MB stdout cap (kills child if exceeded), a configurable timeout (default 120 s for analysis, 55 s for assistant), and passes --disable-mcp --disable-subagents --disable-tool-groups with an explicit read,edit,execute,... list, ensuring Bob runs in a sandboxed ask mode with no filesystem or network access during extraction.

maintenance_improvement.observation: Batch cost aggregation uses costes[0] as fallback when not every element is a number (line 333: '? Number(...) : costes[0]'). If mixed numeric/undefined costs are returned across parallel tasks, the reported catalog.bob.coste silently drops all but the first task's cost instead of summing what is available or flagging the gap. The fix is to sum only the numeric elements and store the count of tasks with known costs alongside, so operators can tell at a glance whether the reported figure is partial: replace the ternary with { coste: costes.filter(c => typeof c === 'number').reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) || null, tareas_con_coste: costes.filter(c => typeof c === 'number').length }.

limits: Source files cover extraction, validation, assistant, and MCP layers only; crawler (network.mjs), route graph (rutas.mjs), search stemmer (buscar.mjs), and audit logic (auditar.mjs) were not supplied and their behavior cannot be verified.
No test files were supplied; correctness of edge cases (e.g., empty bloques, all batches failing) is inferred from control-flow reading, not from observed test output.
Runtime behavior of Bob Shell (the child process spawned via runBob) depends on external BOB_ENTRY binary and BOB_API_KEY; actual LLM responses and cost figures cannot be assessed from source alone.
The review pass (reviewPrompt / acceptReview) is conditionally skipped when BOB_VERIFICAR=0; whether it is enabled in production deployments cannot be determined from these files.
catalogDocuments enforces a maxPages=40 hard ceiling; sites with more crawled pages silently omit lower-ranked pages with no operator alert beyond the paginas_omitidas counter in calidad.
